questions.q: Which tendency is described as the largest group in Gretchen Rubin's quiz?
questions.why: The text says the largest group are Obligers.

questions.q: What is the main risk of treating the tendency framework as fixed?
a: It becomes an excuse and limits change
questions.why: The warning is that stone‑walling the type can become an excuse.

questions.q: Which tendency struggles most with putting others before themselves?
questions.why: Obligers are noted for always putting everyone else first.

questions.q: What does the author say about the success of different tendencies?
a: No type is inherently more successful
questions.why: Gretchen states no type is more successful or happier than another.

questions.q: What early experience does the book use to illustrate growing expectations?
a: Parents praising basic actions like eating
questions.why: The text mentions parents celebrating eating, clapping for pooping, etc.
